title: Pet Grooming Marketing Agency | More Bookings | TailWerks

facts.fact: TailWerks lists Essentials as $297 per month per location, and it can run on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth.
facts.quote: Essentials can run on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth for $297/month per location.

facts.fact: TailWerks lists its Foundation package as starting at $997 per month per location.
facts.quote: Starting at$997 per month, per location

facts.fact: TailWerks lists its Growth package as starting at $1,497 per month per location.
facts.quote: Starting at$1,497 per month, per location

facts.fact: TailWerks says the Scale package is quoted privately and is available after six months on Growth.
facts.quote: Quoted privately after six months on Growth

facts.fact: According to TailWerks, the separate $297 monthly Essentials fee per location ends when a client starts Scale, while usage and applicable third-party charges continue.
facts.quote: The separate $297 monthly Essentials fee per location ends when Scale starts; usage and applicable third-party charges continue.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that standalone Essentials does not include advertising, SEO, a website, or AI phone answering.
facts.quote: Standalone Essentials does not include advertising, SEO, a website, or AI phone answering.

facts.fact: TailWerks says Essentials includes one small prioritized workflow improvement each month once the core system is operating.
facts.quote: Includes one small prioritized workflow improvement each month once the core system is operating.

facts.fact: TailWerks says usage and applicable third-party charges are separate from its monthly management fees.
facts.quote: Usage and applicable third-party charges remain separate.

facts.fact: TailWerks says Scale is available to established Growth clients, after six months on Growth.
facts.quote: Scale, after six months on Growth

facts.fact: TailWerks states that Foundation, Growth, and Scale build on one another, with Growth continuing Foundation and Scale including Growth and Essentials.
facts.quote: Foundation, Growth, and Scale build on one another.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that final deliverables for its packages are agreed in writing.
facts.quote: Final deliverables are agreed in writing.

facts.fact: TailWerks says it works with grooming salons, mobile groomers, and franchises.
facts.quote: TailWerks works with grooming salons, mobile groomers, and franchises

facts.fact: Foundation plus Essentials starts at $1,294 per month per location, according to TailWerks.
facts.quote: Foundation plus Essentials starts at $1,294/month per location.

facts.fact: Growth plus Essentials starts at $1,794 per month per location, according to TailWerks.
facts.quote: Growth plus Essentials starts at $1,794/month per location.

facts.fact: Essentials uses a six-month rolling contract.
facts.quote: Essentials uses a six-month rolling contract.

facts.fact: Foundation has an initial six-month commitment.
facts.quote: Foundation has an initial six-month commitment; Growth uses a six-month rolling contract.

facts.fact: Growth uses a six-month rolling contract.
facts.quote: Growth uses a six-month rolling contract.

facts.fact: Scale is quoted privately, requires six months on Growth first, and uses a six-month rolling contract.
facts.quote: Scale is quoted privately, requires six months on Growth first, and uses a six-month rolling contract.

facts.fact: Ad spend is paid separately to the advertising platforms and is not included in the TailWerks fee.
facts.quote: Ad spend is paid separately to the platforms.

facts.fact: Hosting, phone, SMS, email, registration, AI usage, premium automation, integration, and third-party software costs are separate from the fee, including when Essentials is bundled into Scale.
facts.quote: Applicable hosting, phone, SMS, email, registration, AI usage, premium automation, integration, and third-party software costs are separate, including when Essentials is bundled into Scale.

facts.fact: Essentials can run alone or alongside Foundation or Growth for a separate fee, and its service scope is included in Scale.
facts.quote: Essentials can run alone or alongside Foundation or Growth for a separate fee; its service scope is included in Scale.

facts.fact: Foundation includes search advertising, local SEO, website work, and tracking, while Growth adds Meta advertising, managed social, and more content work.
facts.quote: TailWerks combines search advertising, local SEO, website work, and tracking in Foundation. Growth adds Meta advertising, managed social, and more content work.

facts.fact: Essentials does not require an advertising package or extra appointment capacity.
facts.quote: No advertising package or extra appointment capacity required

facts.fact: Each extra van in a mobile grooming business is not assumed to be a separate package location.
facts.quote: each extra van is not assumed to be a separate package location.

facts.fact: Multi-location and franchise pricing is custom and confirmed in writing rather than applying one formula.
facts.quote: Multi-location and franchise pricing is custom.

facts.fact: A form submission is treated as an inquiry until the booking process confirms the appointment.
facts.quote: A form submission is an inquiry until your booking process confirms the appointment.

facts.fact: A booking link is different from an integration that can read or change appointments, and TailWerks does not promise a two-way connection based on a software name alone.
facts.quote: A booking link is different from an integration that can read or change appointments.

facts.fact: Essentials rebooking and reminder workflows do not guarantee repeat visits or eliminate missed appointments.
facts.quote: they do not guarantee repeat visits or eliminate missed appointments.

facts.fact: Paid advertising work includes checking competing clients and confirming the protected service category and market in writing.
facts.quote: we also check competing clients and confirm the protected service category and market in writing.

facts.fact: TailWerks' Essentials service costs $297 per month per location, whether purchased on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth.
facts.quote: It costs $297/month per location on its own or alongside Foundation or Growth.

facts.fact: Foundation has an initial six-month commitment.
facts.quote: Foundation has an initial six-month commitment;

facts.fact: Scale requires six months on Growth first and then uses a six-month rolling contract, with pricing and scope confirmed in writing.
facts.quote: Scale requires six months on Growth first and uses a six-month rolling contract, with pricing and scope confirmed in writing.

facts.fact: Under Scale, the separate $297 monthly Essentials fee per location ends because Scale includes the Essentials service scope in its private quote.
facts.quote: Scale includes the Essentials service scope in its private quote, so the separate $297 monthly Essentials fee per location ends.

facts.fact: Essentials sends missed-call texts and supports approved follow-up but does not answer live calls or staff the inbox.
facts.quote: Essentials sends missed-call texts and supports approved follow-up; it does not answer live calls or staff your inbox.

facts.fact: Advertising spend is billed separately from the monthly management fee, as are hosting, software, phone, SMS, email, registration, AI usage, premium automation, and integration costs.
facts.quote: Advertising spend is separate. Applicable hosting, software, phone, SMS, email, registration, AI usage, premium automation, and integration costs are also separate

facts.fact: Foundation includes a complete website build within the approved scope when a rebuild is the right approach.
facts.quote: Foundation includes a complete website build within the approved scope when a rebuild is the right approach.

facts.fact: Calls and forms show inquiries but do not by themselves prove a booked or completed groom, according to TailWerks.
facts.quote: Calls and forms show inquiries; they do not by themselves prove a booked or completed groom.

facts.fact: TailWerks states that bookings and rankings are not guaranteed.
facts.quote: Bookings and rankings are not guaranteed.

facts.fact: Growth requires usable photos or footage and updates about the business from the client team.
facts.quote: Growth also needs usable photos or footage and updates about the business.
